name: service-levels
title: Service levels
description: Commitments in numbers: response times by priority, each defined in a sentence, and uptime targets with the downtime they allow and the credit owed.
docs: Pass support (a priority code, an optional name, a one-sentence definition, the first response, the update interval and the channels) and availability (the uptime target, what it allows per month, the service credit and optionally the plan it belongs to). Add hours for the line under the tables that says when support applies, and slaHref for a link to the full agreement. The two tables sit side by side from 76rem, the inside of an 80rem page container, and stack on anything narrower so neither column is cramped; both switch together between real tables and lists of cards with the same labels, so on a phone nothing hides in a horizontal scroll. Figures are tabular, and both tables have captions. Words are translated through labels.
